tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows leukocytosis, mild erythrocytopenia, and increased platelet size and distribution width, suggesting possible reactive or inflammatory processes. Hemoglobin, hematocrit, and platelet count are within normal limits. Correlation with clinical findings and further evaluation for infection, inflammation, or hematologic disorders is recommended.
